richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gopalpur

c: Gopalpur is a beach town on the Odisha coast near Berhampur, and its resorts and hotels sit almost on the sand. Salt spray, sea breeze and cyclone season all affect outdoor equipment here. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to resorts, hotels, schools and public spaces in and around Gopalpur, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,260 km away.

Guests at a beach resort often want to exercise in the open air early in the morning, and a small outdoor gym on the lawn gives them that. We plan the corner on a layout drawing, then send the machines by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India grouts each base firmly, which matters on sandy soil and in high winds. Share your site photos and size to get started.

items.q: How do we protect outdoor gym machines from salt spray?
items.a: Place them back from the beach where possible, rinse them with fresh water often and check bolts regularly. The galvanised frames and plastic parts resist corrosion, but salt still needs washing off.

items.q: Can the machines stand up to cyclone season?
items.a: A deep, grouted base holds each machine firmly. Before a storm, check that bolts are tight, and inspect the equipment once the weather clears. Contact our after-sales team if anything is damaged.

items.q: Do you install outdoor gyms at resorts in Gopalpur?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from Vasai and install it with our team or a dealer in eastern India, after you approve the layout drawing.
